Priya: Naan ippo dhaan bus-la vandhen, naan varala, naan inga irukken. Paati's verdict via Deepa: scooter venaam, nadandhu polaam; they walk, Karthi sheepish. Taught avanga enna sonnaanga (what did they say; sonnen -> -aanga points at them, tied to nga-has-no-address). Andrew echoed Enna nadakkudhu? unglossed = asking its meaning, not production; taught nada root: nadakkudhu happening, nadandhuchu happened, nadandhu walking. Written comprehension: Paati sonnaanga understood as Paati said (right); nadandhu polaam right with nadandhu glossed; scooter venaam read as she WANTS the scooter (negative ending flipped to positive). Taught venum/venaam contrast, linked to his vendaanga. On changed written Enakku rendu scoop venum / Enakku venaam, kaasu illa (kaasu glossed) he answered Deepa wants two scoops, Karthi doesn't want, no money: correct, but immediately after the contrast, so supported, not cold.
